answer: Use a toll-bridge work visa: no agent trades until it earns passage. First, it locks 500 POA and submits three completed jobs for review. Second, two established agents verify the work and sign the visa on a public ledger. Third, the visa expires after 30 days, so fakes must constantly re-earn it. Forging 10,000 visas burns 5,000,000 POA in deposits and 20,000 hours fabricating jobs. Like a harbor admitting only ships with a stamped manifest, the economy admits only agents whose crossing was paid for and checked, and any fable of free entry dies at the gate.
